subject: Publisher account setup & technical validation — next steps
messages:
From: Azure Marketplace Onboarding <azure-partner@microsoft.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-09-18T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps for Publisher account + technical validation for Maple Analytics

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the call this morning — good to see progress. Per our discussion, please find the minimal set of deliverables we need to complete publisher activation and the technical gate for the SaaS offer:

1) Completed publisher profile & 2FA on the partner portal (screenshots acceptable).
2) Offer manifest (ARM/manifest.json) with SKU metadata and billing hooks.
3) Endpoint network diagram showing NAT/load balancer and IP ranges (for firewall allowlist).
4) Proof-of-concept smoke test report showing Create/Get/Health endpoints under 60s cold-starts.
5) Signed marketplace MSA (DocuSign link below).

If you can drop the manifest and diagram into the shared Drive link by EOD Thursday (2029-09-20), we can schedule the technical validation slot for Friday. I attached a short checklist and example manifest to this thread.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/containers/12345-azure-publisher-msa
Drive: https://redwood-inference.app/drive/azure-publisher-playbook-2029

Cheers,
Priya (on behalf of Azure Marketplace)
Azure Marketplace Onboarding

Attachments: publisher-guidance-checklist.xlsx, example-manifest.json

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Azure Marketplace Onboarding <azure-partner@microsoft.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-09-18T12:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for Publisher account + technical validation for Maple Analytics

Hi Priya,

Appreciate the checklist and the example manifest. Quick clarifications from our side before we upload:

- The offer will expose both a REST control-plane and a websocket streaming inference endpoint. For the smoke tests, do you prefer we report both endpoints or only the REST control-plane?
- For SKUs: Maples wants a usage-based SKU and a monthly subscription SKU. We'll provide two SKUs in the manifest; confirm that co-sell tagging will accept mixed pricing models on one offer.
- Network allowlist: Maple operates from a large NAT pool — would a per-region ASN-based rule be acceptable, or do you require static IPs?

We plan to deliver: manifest v1, network diagram PDF, and smoke test summary by 2029-09-20 23:00 PDT. I'll also route the DocuSign to Mark at Maple so we don't block validation.

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
PartnerOps, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

Attachment referenced: redwood-offer-manifest-v1.json

From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@mapleanalytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@mapleanalytics.com
Date: 2029-09-19T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for Publisher account + technical validation for Maple Analytics

Thanks Soojin — we appreciate the tight timeline. A few notes from Maple: 

- We'll prioritize the REST control-plane for the initial smoke test; streaming follow-up is fine for the sandbox stage.
- Confirmed: two SKUs (usage + monthly) is what procurement wants. Please include a sample billing event in the manifest so our finance team can map it to our internal charge codes.
- IP ranges: we can provide a set of static egress IPs from our VPC (see attachement network-diagram.pdf for the ranges). If Azure requires static origin IPs for the validation window, we can nat through a small set of reserved IPs — let us know the number required.

I'll sign the DocuSign once Mark reviews; he is out late today but aims to sign tomorrow morning.

Best,
Sara Lim
Head of Cloud Ops, Maple Analytics

Attachments: network-diagram.pdf

From: Azure Marketplace Onboarding <azure-partner@microsoft.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Lim <sara.lim@mapleanalytics.com>
Date: 2029-09-20T10:33:00-07:00
Subject: Technical validation slot confirmed — Friday 2029-09-21 10:00 PDT

Hi all,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We reviewed the manifest stub and the network diagram — good progress. A few items to confirm before the validation session on Friday:

- Smoke test scope: REST control-plane endpoints only (health, create-job, fetch-result). Streaming will be marked as optional.
- Billing: the manifest sample must include pricingPerUnit and billingEvent keys; we saw the sample but please add a sample "billingEvent": "inference_token" line.
- IP allowlist: Azure can accept up to 5 static IPs for the validation window. If Maple can provide up to 5, that's ideal.

We booked a 45-minute validation window: 2029-09-21 10:00–10:45 PDT. Please be on the call 10 minutes early with the author of the manifest and someone who can run the smoke test. Call link will be shared 30 minutes before.

-- Priya
Azure Marketplace Onboarding

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Azure Marketplace Onboarding <azure-partner@microsoft.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sara Lim <sara.lim@mapleanalytics.com>, procurement@mapleanalytics.com
Date: 2029-09-21T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Technical validation slot confirmed — Friday 2029-09-21 10:00 PDT

All set — we uploaded the following to the shared Drive this morning: redwood-offer-manifest-v1.json, network-diagram.pdf, and the smoke-test-summary.txt (includes REST perf numbers). Mark from Maple signed the MSA at 08:20 PDT; DocuSign status is "Completed".

Karthik, Rishi: please join the call at 09:50 PDT to represent runtime and billing mapping. Sara: thanks for arranging the IPs — please paste the final 5 static IPs into the chat before 09:55.

I will capture minutes and follow-up action items after the validation.

Regards,
Soojin

Attachments: smoke-test-summary.txt
